title: StreetDetail
description: Street details, in the context of address.

addressGeneral3.description: (if applicable) Third line of a free form address.

suiteNumber.description: Number of the apartment or suite.

floorIdentification.description: The identification by name or number, expressed as text, of the floor in the building as part of this address.

addressGeneral.description: First line of a free form address or some additional address information (for example a mail stop).

buildingName.description: (if applicable) In certain cases the physical location of the place of interest does not have a direct point of entry from the street, but may be located inside a larger structure such as a building, complex, office block, apartment, etc.

withinTownLimits.description: True if this street is within the legal geographical boundaries of the specified town (default).

code.description: (if applicable) Utilities often make use of external reference systems, such as those of the town-planner's department or surveyor general's mapping system, that allocate global reference codes to streets.

prefix.description: Prefix to the street name. For example: North, South, East, West.

type.description: Type of street. Examples include: street, circle, boulevard, avenue, road, drive, etc.

addressGeneral2.description: (if applicable) Second line of a free form address.

number.description: Designator of the specific location on the street.

suffix.description: Suffix to the street name. For example: North, South, East, West.
